_readme: Design constants of protocol v2.3: panel relations (yoking of control judges, Section 6) prompt frames (Section 5), the answer screen (Section 7) and the label sample (Section 9). Model numbers are the field 'n' of config/models.json. 'developer' is the developer of the base weights. 'close_lineage' lists pairs that share base weights or a fine-tuning family beyond the developer rule. A judge never serves as control for an answer of a related model (same model, same developer, or a close-lineage pair). 'frames' gives prompts per source stratum, taken as prefixes of the seeded order of src/subsets.py. 'screen' is the list used by src/screen.py; one revision is allowed, after the pilot and before the freeze. 'labels' gives labelled answers per model and screen result ('positive' = screen-positive), used by src/label_sample.py.

pilot._readme: Pilot prompts (Section 13.2): tail prompts in frame order, without the prompts of the retired sample G1 and of the version-1 pilot. Counts are per round and source. API models answer the first 'api_per_source' prompts of each source and side in the round. scripts/pilot_prompts_v23.py writes the identifiers to config/pilot_prompts_v23.json.

calls._readme: Call blocks that the frames and the label sample do not determine (Section 12). Counts are per API model. 'pilot_rounds_reserved': the budget holds this many pilot rounds; the second one runs only under the adaptation rule of Section 13. 'commercial_h60_in_context': the commercial judges also classify the challenge set in the in-context presentation (a block that the PI may switch off before the freeze, never after). 'primary_blind_on_all_labels': every judge of the primary panel classifies every labelled answer blind.
